description:
A build tool for Scala, Java, and more


Vulnerability fix for IO.unzip
sbt team received a security report GHSA-p8jf-532w-4p65 from Stas Shevchenko that despite previous attempt to fix it, IO.unzip and its variants contain a zip slip vulerability. sbt 1.13.1 and 2.0.12 fix this bug.
updates and bug fixes
- fix: End the client connection when the channel's write thread stops by @retronym in #9991
- Update sbtn to 2.1.0-e5346417 in #9996
- fix: Fix run task by @xuwei-k in #9963
- IO 1.13.6 by @eed3si9n in #9989
- Zinc 2.0.5 + IPC Socket 1.8.1 by @eed3si9n in #9993
Full Changelog: v2.0.11...v2.0.12
